market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $108 oil, Fed hawkish pivot, and consumer squeeze. Expect volatility in energy and rate-sensitive sectors. AI names may see pullback on slowdown narrative but infrastructure (TSMC, MU) holds. Defense and value retail outperform. 1-3 month: cautious, range-bound with downside risk on oil spike.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: AI capex cycle remains intact despite slowdown rhetoric; TSMC/Micron benefit from HBM shortage. Defense spending structurally elevated. Energy transition (solar, storage) faces storage bottleneck but policy support continues. Consumer remains pressured until energy stabilizes. Geopolitical fragmentation (BRICS, Xi-Modi) reshapes trade flows. Higher rates persist, favoring financials and short-duration.
